name: piano_theme
character: A close grand piano in free fall: the theme stated bare, each note left to ring while the room around it keeps stretching.
description: The figure: an eight-note descent-ascent in D phrygian, stated alone, doubled in octaves at the crush, broken into a two-note fragment in the dilation, and left as one D at the horizon.
sources: KB cinematic-hybrid-scoring | the figure must be stated early and small so its later doubling reads as the same shape grown, not a new tune
KB soundfont-velocity-and-realism section 4 | one sample per key, so velocity_timbre darkens the soft statements per note: a starting-value curve, not measured on this bank
ESTIMATE: azimuth 0 deg, 8 deg up, 1.6 m, gain -2 dB, HP 90 Hz and the 260 Hz dip are starting values for a close grand in a very large room
